summary: Full daily research refresh: reassessed the tracked Power Stack universe across US, Hong Kong/China and Malaysia. No formal conviction upgrade/downgrade or new stock promotion cleared the bar. Robotics commercialization order remains fixed/warehouse automation, cobots/mobile manipulation, industrial humanoids, open-world robots. Added data/powerstack-update-2026-08-23.json and refreshed macro/ISM research; no site code, UI, scoring, automation or backend changes.
